title: Quantum relations in the general setting: composition and adjacency operators
summary: Quantum relations in the sense of Weaver are $M'$-bimodules, for a von Neumann algebra $M$, these generalising actual relations on a set $X$ when $M=\ell^\infty(X)$. Similarly, relations between two sets can be generalised as bimodules over the commutants of two algebras. We make an explicit study of this idea, developing some tools to check that constructions are well-defined.
